verdict.rationale: Text was extracted verbatim from several public canada.ca guidance pages (business registration overview, e-services, EFILE, the CRA landing page), and a direct probe of canada.ca returned HTTP 200. Together these suggest the public reading surface serves readable content to an automated fetcher without a wall in front. The evidence is indirect: no probe explicitly records the user agent used or confirms the absence of a bot wall, CAPTCHA, or JS-only rendering. missing for 10: explicit probe confirming access with an identified agent user agent, explicit confirmation of server-rendered HTML (no JS-only shell), and independent corroboration that no bot or CAPTCHA challenge is applied.
